A king among beasts, it unleashes utter destruction with its charges and shock waves. As immovable as the earth itself, it attacks relentlessly with enough force to shatter mountains. Once it begins its rampage, slaying it is the only way to stop it, leaving no choice but a desperate fight to the death.

An extremely dangerous being that rampages with extraordinary power.
It uses the combat experience accumulated over its many years of operation to improve its own capabilities. With overwhelming firepower, it can dominate vast areas and annihilate entire armies without allowing a single foe to escape.

An extremely dangerous being that rampages with extraordinary power.
It does more than adapt to extreme cold. It releases such intense cold that it chills its surroundings, creating conditions that favor it. It will stop at nothing to bring down its target, relentlessly attacking until its prey is cornered.

A species of agile carnivore that races across the grasslands in packs.
A Land Fox variant adapted to life on the harsh tundra. Its exceptionally keen hearing lets it pinpoint the sounds of small animals hidden beneath the snow. Even a human holding their breath is easily detected.

A species of agile carnivore that races across the grasslands in packs.
It has survived the fierce struggle for life in the snowy mountains by giving free rein to its fighting instincts. It is also cunning, and is said to have learned to manipulate dark engrams to challenge larger creatures despite its small size.

The lord of the snowy mountains, commanding the beasts that dwell in the frozen wilds.
Proud and fearless, it challenges even dragons to battle. The flames within its body are said to burn away everything, from freezing winds to the mightiest foes.

A monster resembling a lizard larger than a human.
A Lizard Ghost that has evolved to survive in frozen lands. It conceals itself by mimicking the surrounding rocks and ice, then hunts prey that passes nearby. Its jaws are powerful enough to crush the frozen carcasses of other creatures.

A bird of prey monster that hunts even large animals.
A Landhawk variant that makes its territory in bitterly cold lands. Its dense plumage offers excellent insulation, allowing it to soar undisturbed through any weather. It is not uncommon for one to burst from a raging blizzard and carry off its prey.

A bird of prey monster that hunts even large animals.
A mysterious Landhawk that roams the skies of the ice world. Its face is badly damaged, and ice engrams spill from its scars. It has reportedly displayed the strange behavior of using these engrams to whip up a blizzard and hide within it.

An extremely dangerous being that rampages with extraordinary power.
Sinister engrams seep through the gaps between scales far harder than steel. Its blazing stare is said to make even the mightiest warriors tremble. Only by overcoming that terror can one earn the right to face it in battle.

A mysterious creature of unknown origin.
It can be found in regions blanketed by wind and snow. Known for shimmering like an aurora, it is said to bring good fortune to anyone who encounters it. One theory even claims it has a bit of a cold.

An outlaw who makes a hideout outside towns or deep in the mountains.
Said to have once held a respectable position before being cast out for wrongdoing. Far too intelligent and skilled for an ordinary bandit, this foe can overwhelm anyone who lets their guard down.

An extremely dangerous being that rampages with extraordinary power.
The bitter regrets of nameless heroes brought down by schemes, plots, and conspiracies have coalesced into a dark, burning mass. Hesitate for even an instant, and its overwhelming storm of attacks will sweep you away. Those who give in to fear can scarcely fight it at all.

An extremely dangerous being that rampages with extraordinary power.
The fire engrams pouring from it generate such intense heat that it seems liable to melt its own body. Even its gaze is said to ignite what it falls upon. Only those with exceptional resolve and skill can hope to confront it.

A Dragon Tribe warrior with an imposing physique and overwhelming strength.
Though immature and lacking in intellect, it can rival even Voldigen in a contest of raw power. Its brutish nature makes it impossible to stop once it rampages, crushing everything in its path.

A grotesque monster said to have been "born of flame and calamity." The hellfire within spills out to engulf its immense body, yet loses none of its fury as it burns everything around it. A symbol of ill omen, its very appearance is feared as "a harbinger of terrible disaster."

An extremely dangerous being that rampages with extraordinary power.
Buffeted by a cruel fate, it destroys all around it as its anguished cries echo through the air. The sight is both terrifying and tragic. Perhaps someone who has attained true strength can free it from its suffering.

An extremely dangerous being that rampages with extraordinary power.
Much of its nature remains a mystery, but there is no doubt that it wields immense strength. Some of the calamities described in ancient legends may well refer to the devastation wrought by its varied and ferocious attacks.

An extremely dangerous being that rampages with extraordinary power.
Its firepower and mobility have both been greatly improved. Enhanced for more tactical deployment, it can launch wide-area attacks and charges. It can adapt to any situation and is devastating in battles of annihilation.

The mightiest Dragon King, whose name resounds across the planet Regnas.
So powerful and terrifying that none may even approach, it is an absolute threat. Across the thousands of years of dragon history, past and future alike, no equal exists.

A mysterious warrior of unknown origins.
Once hailed as a hero powerful enough to change the course of the world, they are now a shadow of their former self. Their skill, however, remains undiminished. They have become a demon, beheading one enemy after another with lightning speed.

An extremely dangerous being that rampages with extraordinary power.
Its strength is said to exceed the bounds of humanity. Look away for an instant, and your head may already be falling. The way it slaughters its enemies without a word may indeed be beyond anything human.

A powerful monster known to have inhabited Koaniani Forest since ancient times. Its appearances cause such devastation that they are counted among the forest's natural disasters. It is remembered as one of the greatest threats in the forest's long history. Anyone who faces it must be prepared to overcome the fury of nature itself.

They skim the ground as though mowing down undergrowth, attacking their prey in swarms. They appear near Forest Reapers and slip in attacks to cover the openings left by their massive companions. Leaving them unchecked can turn a battle into an unexpectedly difficult fight.

Always appears lurking in the Forest Reaper's shadow, relying on its intimidating presence. It is rarely a threat on its own, but its interference during a fight with the Forest Reaper is both troublesome and extremely dangerous.

A Forest Reaper transformed by the vast stores of ice engrams accumulated within its body. It scatters ice and snow from its massive frame like a raging blizzard, making even an approach difficult. It freezes all life, shrouding the forest in the silence of death. It is said that nothing moves in its wake.
A Tiny Reaper cloaked in ice engrams. It releases cold air to stagger its enemies and make escape easier. It usually hides behind other monsters and rarely ventures to the front.

A pleasant breeze sweeps through these hills.
In the village of Minsterhorn, the steady wind keeps
the famous local windmills turning.

A trade route to Ritze has crossed these foothills since ancient times.
Recent attacks like the one on Bergmar Village have given the route
a reputation for danger. Goblins have a settlement here, too.
Even the Oracle Priestess now takes seasoned guards with her
when she makes her pilgrimage.
Menacing Dragon Ridge

A mountainous region in the northern Granville Ice World.
Fierce blizzards and active volcanoes make this land so harsh
that it is said no living creature can survive here.
Deep within towers the sacred Mount Bernardus, a place so remote
that it is known as the end of the world.
White Dragon Snowfield

A snowy region in the southern Granville Ice World.
Despite its relentless winds, snow, and bitter cold,
it is considered one of the more manageable parts of the Granville Ice World.
Known as the home of dragonkind, it is avoided by most people.
Stellar Aurora

Beautiful ribbons of light stream across the night sky over the Granville Ice World.
Known as the Stellar Aurora, this phenomenon remains shrouded in mystery.
It only occurs rarely, so if you see it,
try taking a picture in Photo Mode.

In some areas, a blizzard begins
when a named enemy appears.
Defeating the named enemy within the time limit
causes special gathering spots to appear for a limited time.
Breakable Ice

Breakable ice gradually cracks when attacked or stood upon,
and eventually shatters, leaving a hole.
Falling through a hole may force you to take a detour,
but it can also lead you to hidden gathering points.

The Forest Reaper is a raid boss that inflicts players
with a special status ailment called Dead Count.

Use the Throwing Action
to increase your remaining Dead Count.
Time Bomb

A Time Bomb explodes after a set time, dealing heavy elemental damage
across a wide area to players only.
The explosion cannot be stopped, so protect yourself with Guardian Shield.
※ T-Skills and dodging cannot prevent damage from the explosion.
Mission Repeat Support

If matchmaking cannot find enough players for an Investigation mission
or Rush Battle, the mission will begin with Imagine companions such as Feste
filling the empty slots.
(They are replaced when other players join the mission.)

While this effect is active, a counter appears that decreases
each time an enemy damages you. Reaching 0 incapacitates you.
You cannot be revived by other players and must immediately respawn,
which inflicts "Loss."
* "Dead Count" cannot be prevented or removed.

While this effect is active, you cannot recover to your maximum HP.
* "Loss" cannot be prevented or removed.

The higher the gauge, the more damage you deal.
If an attack makes you lose enough HP, the gauge resets.
Dodge attacks and use buffs that let you absorb HP.

At a Memory Stand, a drink made with activated Liquid Memory
grants you a Liquid Memory effect.
One such effect increases the number of items you gather.
These effects wear off after a set number of actions or a certain
amount of time, but they can be a big help while they last.

Increased Gathering Yield
With this Liquid Memory active,
you get more materials each time you gather.
It activates as you defeat enemies in the field and as time passes.

Reduced Gathering Time
This Liquid Memory
increases your gathering speed, reducing the time it takes to gather.
It activates as you clear missions and as time passes.
Stats
Mount Equipment

Your “Memory Case” holds all the Liquid Memory bottles
you’ve collected so far.
You can check each Liquid Memory’s effect, grade (effect strength),
and activation conditions, among other details.

Liquid Memories have useful effects, like giving you more materials each time
you gather, but they’re hard to come by.
Completing certain quests is one way to earn bottles,
so try your hand at a variety of activities.
Turning Your Character in Place

will not leave you weakened.
If you see an incapacitated player,
be sure to help them back up.

Tell me, how does this Chronoleap business work?
Could you let me in on it, just a little?

Oh, I've no plans to misuse it, mind you.
Just a little healthy curiosity, eh? Quite!

Of course. I can tell you a little.
I trust you all. You know that, don't you?

Yes. The greater the span of time one leaps across,
the more chronogram it takes.
The trouble is, chronogram is terribly scarce…

All I could gather was just enough
to bring Tyris and me to this era.

I see.
And how would one go about making this chronogram[――]

Don't go getting any ideas, all right?
Staying alive is part of an adventurer's job, too.
Mooom, what about the Sacred Pillar cookies?

As I mentioned,
everything to do with Chronoleaps is strictly confidential.

That goes for chronogram as well, of course.
Please take care never to speak of it to anyone else.

Thieves and bandits are a dime a dozen,
but attacking a traveling troupe onstage? That bothers me.

It's a big world.
Get out there and see it with your own eyes.

But there's been a bit of an accident.
It's dangerous in there right now.

We had no choice but to pull back here.
We're working out what to do next.
Do we really have to abandon the place...?

Then, a while back, there was a huge explosion underground.
The Order's been in charge of the place ever since.
From what I hear, no one really knows what caused it.
Oh, listen to me. I'd better leave it there.
We're going to catch it for this...

Whatever brought him there,
he struck me as someone quite out of the ordinary.

She can be a real piece of work,
but underneath it all, she's a soft touch.

The old man at the Coin Inn says it's his treat. Hear that?
You should go right now. In fact, get going. Heh heh...

Hey, nice work!
Looks like you've got those jobs well in hand. So good!

Run into the dragons or Avaritia lately?
I've been asking around since we last talked...

It's like I thought. The dragons are up to something.
They've changed the way they operate.

Come to think of it, that attack on the Duchy of Bernhardt was odd, too.
Word is, the dragons actually "pulled back" partway through.

Used to be, once a fight started, it was kill or be killed.
That's what made the dragons so dangerous...

Between that and Avaritia, I smell trouble.
If things start looking bad, give me a shout. Anytime.

Professor Walkin said something about wanting
to investigate the Giant Tower Ruins.

Once the professor gets an idea, it's straight to work.
I didn't get a chance to ask for details.

The priests of the Bapharian Church teach us
how to use the relics of Bapharia.

I hear that's why the priests spend so much time
studying those relics.

I guess you have to be pretty sharp
to make it as a priest.
You know how Bapharian relics turn up in ruins?

Once the priests are sure they're safe,
people start using them around town and such.

They are a crystallization of human feelings and Engrams.
Even the relics of Bapharia cannot create one.

A dormant Imagine can be awakened,
but to create one from nothing is impossible.

How do they come into being, I wonder...
Hmm. I do not know. A mystery indeed.

Just getting in there is tough.
That's part of the adventure. Show 'em what you're made of!

Well... the Church sent me in on a maintenance job,
so I only saw the lower floors.
Got everything you need, adventurer?

Once you get the hang of adventuring, that's when to be careful.
It's the old hands who take their preparations most seriously.

You're hardly a newcomer anymore.
Make sure you're ready each time you head out.

Change classes?
They used to be pretty easygoing about who came through the checkpoint.

I know Lord Dunkirk's here,
but do they all have to be so on edge?

Well, well. You brought me a souvenir?
There's a first time for everything.

Don't be silly. A souvenir from such an outrageously pretty little thing?
I'd be struck down for turning it away.

A lot of the ruins and caves in the Evergreen Desert
are dangerous places. Watch yourself out there.

I could've sworn I saw the Oracle Priestess
just a little while ago…

Pilgrimages are grueling, from what I hear.
A little breather now and then does you good.

I take my eyes off her for a second and she's bloody well gone.
She does make our work difficult.

So please, if you'd be so kind,
do look for Lady Einrain.

Oh, it's nothing… These are dangerous times, aren't they?
Even I get a little curious.

Hey! I saw you with some lovely ladies earlier!
Where'd they go?
Hmm... I have it!

...There's a story there, huh? OK!
Since it's you guys asking, count me in.
Take the path on the left! She's up ahead!

You're the adventurer who saved the chickens!
And you're here to help me again!

Our cows! Can you believe it?!
They're so cute! And so tasty!

I won't stand for it!
I'll teach those bullies a lesson!
Come on, adventurer! Let's do this together!

Come find me when you're done, okay?
Now then, let's get to it!

No holding back! No going easy!
No hesitation! No mercy!

Let's take down five apiece
so our cows can graze in peace!

I took the whole herd apart,
so I don't think they'll be picking on our cows again!

We can all rest easy now.
We have you to thank for that, adventurer.

Everyone in the village sends their thanks,
and you should've seen how happy that cow looked!

Oh, she was SUCH a cutie!
And all that firm muscle! What a beauty!

Such a healthy glow, such firm skin,
and the way she looked at me with those round little eyes...
Oh, I can't stand it! I could just eat her up!

So let's do just that!
Here, adventurer! I saved you a share!

Fresh-cut sirloin! Choice beef that'll make your mouth water!
I butchered her myself while I was waiting!

See how pretty it is, all red and pink?
You won't find a finer cut anywhere!

She was such a lovely cow. I bet she tastes divine!
Ooh, I'm drooling! ♪ Dab, dab.

I trimmed out every bit of sinew without a nick in the meat.
I know my way around a butcher's knife!

Huh? Is something the matter?
Oh, don't be shy. Go on, take it!

Thank you so much!
If anything picks on the cows again, you'll come help, right?

Congratulations! You've reached Adventurer Rank 7.
I look forward to seeing what you do next.

When a rank-up battle becomes available,
come talk to me again.

You need to manage your stamina in combat too.
A good adventurer keeps an eye on the whole fight.

In this rank-up battle, you'll come across
a mechanism that can inflict Bind.

Bind holds you in place. You can't move at all.
You'll need a way to deal with it to get through.
Not enough Engram stacks.
They used to be pretty easygoing about who came through the checkpoint.

I know Lord Dunkirk's here,
but do they all have to be so on edge?

He may be the strongest knight alive, but what does he know about politics?
I wonder if he's got anyone to help him.

She's still just a kid, you know?
Poor thing, being made to walk all that way.

Well, well. You brought me a souvenir?
There's a first time for everything.

Don't be silly. A souvenir from such an outrageously pretty little thing?
I'd be struck down for turning it away.

A lot of the ruins and caves in the Evergreen Desert
are dangerous places. Watch yourself out there.

We've got some amazing performers!
My singing draws the biggest crowds, of course. Hee hee!

I saw a child I didn't recognize playing with my son.
A traveler, I'd say, or a pilgrim.

I could've sworn I saw the Oracle Priestess
just a little while ago…

Pilgrimages are grueling, from what I hear.
A little breather now and then does you good.

I take my eyes off her for a second and she's bloody well gone.
She does make our work difficult.

You'd think the head of the temple, of all people,
could damn well sit still for a minute.

So please, if you'd be so kind,
do look for Lady Einrain.

Oh, it's nothing… These are dangerous times, aren't they?
Even I get a little curious.

I wonder if the songstress sings even better than that girl.
I really wanna hear her!

That girl who tells the boring stories?
She told that one just for me.

Then she came over.
She told me a story to take my mind off it!

Hey! I saw you with some lovely ladies earlier!
Where'd they go?
Hmm... I have it!

Would you keep an eye on them for us, on the quiet?
...They get into rather more scrapes than you'd think.

...There's a story there, huh? OK!
Since it's you guys asking, count me in.

Whoops, I wasn't supposed to pry. Sorry!
Leave the rest to me.
Take the path on the left! She's up ahead!

The names engraved here
will endure far into the future.
...There you are!
By the way, who are your friends?
Him? He's run off with a pretty songstress. Young love!

There was a girl with a traveling troupe. Some strange people were after her.
He took her to a hideout to keep her safe...
O-oh! So that's what you meant.
You're a fine one to talk. A bit shy about courting, aren't you?

Something's been bothering me a little,
so I asked the two of them to look into it.
Still, I'm glad he thinks that much of us.

Well, that answers most of my questions.
Thank you for coming, Einrain.

O-of course.
I'd taken that to be part of the job all along.
Thank you. I'll leave her in your care.

Tell a few truths, and no one thinks to ask about the thing
you really want to hide... I do it myself all the time.

It's convenient to imagine the ruins are all cannons and ancient weapons.
But the spectacular things aren't all that people left behind.

The Bapharian Order is hiding something!
They must have a secret they can't afford to let the public discover!

That alone proves my theory touches on the truth!
I won't back down!

Adventurers are seldom allowed in on their own.
Someone from the Bapharian faith usually accompanies them.

You have your permit, so I have no objection.
Please, enter.

So I won't ask any questions.
Besides, the lady with you looks quite exhausted.

Well, if you came up empty, you came up empty.
You'll find out in time. Don't rush it.

Something terrible happened to the man
who used to stand guard here with me...

It's hard to bear, but he died doing his duty.
I'll keep standing guard here and do my best to honor him.
The fellow who stood guard here before me took his duties seriously.
What, are you lot still here?

It sounded almost like the cry of some creature, but I couldn't quite tell…

Whatever it was, I'd never heard anything like it.
It made my skin crawl…

Oh, it's you lot.
Did you do something to help us, by any chance?

Oh, don't tell me!
It was probably some weird monster, wasn't it?

You killed it for us, right?
Then that's all I need to know. Thank you very much.
Hey! How'd you fare against that tough monster?!

Hey there. Fellow adventurer, are you?
Then you'd better watch yourself.

And I might still be short on supplies…
I'll have to stock up on those, too.

The grown-ups told me I wasn't allowed out of town.

Comedy sketches, dancing, street acts…
This troupe really is the best!

I haven't much time left.
The one pleasure I still had to look forward to was hearing her sing…

My ancestors… God of Bapharia…
Anyone who can hear me, please let that girl be saved.
Attacking in the middle of a show, right in front of everyone! Are they mad?!

Did they have some reason to be in such a hurry?
Or…

Good heavens!

Listen, adventurer. I've no standing, no money, no power,

Will you rescue her? If this goes on,

The terror on that girl's face…
We can't just leave her to them!

Huh? A bunch of rough-looking types
went running out of town after one girl.
Please, hurry to her.

Some of our youngsters went after them,
but I do worry whether they'll be enough…

The voice she has now, the way she sings this year…
I'm a little sad I didn't get to hear the whole song.

Dear Charlotte is what gives my life its sweetness.
She's the oasis that appears before a dying traveler!

You know, when I've just seen a traveling troupe perform,
I feel like I've woken up from the most vivid dream.

This dream did get a little rough halfway through, though.
I hope next time we can relax and enjoy it.

There could be more of that lot hiding out around here,
so I'm keeping watch.
Next time, I've got to be the one to keep them safe…

She takes her responsibilities so much to heart.
I hope she won't go blaming herself for what's happened…

If I'd kept a better handle on things,
she'd have been spared such a fright.

At a Memory Stand, a drink made with activated Liquid Memory
grants you a Liquid Memory effect.
One such effect increases the number of items you gather.
These effects wear off after a set number of actions or a certain
amount of time, but they can be a big help while they last.

Increased Gathering Yield
With this Liquid Memory active,
you get more materials each time you gather.
It activates as you defeat enemies in the field and as time passes.

Reduced Gathering Time
This Liquid Memory
increases your gathering speed, reducing the time it takes to gather.
It activates as you clear missions and as time passes.
Stats
Mount Equipment

Your “Memory Case” holds all the Liquid Memory bottles
you’ve collected so far.
You can check each Liquid Memory’s effect, grade (effect strength),
and activation conditions, among other details.

Liquid Memories have useful effects, like giving you more materials each time
you gather, but they’re hard to come by.
Completing certain quests is one way to earn bottles,
so try your hand at a variety of activities.
Turning Your Character in Place

1  Dead Count
While active, a counter decreases each time you take damage from an enemy.
When the counter reaches 0, you become incapacitated.
You cannot be rescued and will be revived immediately.
You receive "Loss" when revived.
* Dead Count cannot be prevented or removed.
  You are also revived immediately if an enemy defeats you while it is active.

2  Loss
While active, you cannot recover to your maximum HP.
* Loss cannot be prevented or removed.
Blitz Lancer Basics

You can now challenge "Sudden Death Battle II"
from the Missions screen.

Taking damage in this mission immediately incapacitates you,
so choose suitable skills and equipment before taking it on.

Plug Bonus Missions under Matching Support
specialize in Ability Plug rewards.
The higher your Adventurer Rank,
the better the effects and the more Ability Plugs you receive.

You can also use a Support Benefit claim
to receive even more Ability Plugs.

Plug Bonus Mission matchmaking selects a mission
at random from Rush Battles you have already cleared.
If no destination is available, your current class level
and Battle Score do not meet any eligible mission's requirements.
Clear a regular Rush Battle first.
Beat Performer Basics

As a Beat Performer, you can set up an Amp in combat.
Hit it with attacks and skills to extend their reach.
Landing hits with these extended attacks fills your Heat Gauge.
When it's full, you can activate High Spirit.
High Spirit powers up your attacks and skills,
so keep up the pressure while it's active.

You can also earn bonus survey points by meeting certain conditions.
Check Event Effects for details.

Extra Battle Imagine have more powerful summoning skills
than ordinary Battle Imagine.

Breakable Ice

Breakable ice gradually cracks when attacked or stood upon,
and eventually shatters, leaving a hole.

Falling through a hole may force you to take a detour,
but it can also lead you to hidden gathering points.

Over time, the holes freeze over again.

In some areas, a blizzard begins
when a named enemy appears.

Visibility is poor during a blizzard, making combat dangerous.
However, defeating the named enemy within the time limit
causes special gathering spots to appear for a limited time.

* If you fail to defeat the named enemy before time runs out,
  the blizzard will stop, but no gathering spots will appear.
Time Bomb

A Time Bomb explodes after a set time, dealing heavy elemental damage
across a wide area to players only.

It begins to glow when activated,
shining brighter as the explosion draws closer.
The explosion cannot be stopped, so protect yourself with Guardian Shield.
※ T-Skills and dodging cannot prevent
  damage from the explosion.

How good of you to stop and talk!
Thanks for lending me your ear♪

My specialty? Songs about local specialties!
Wherever I go, I sing about what the place is famous for.

You get the idea. I thought I'd start with a song
about the village where I was born, but...

Right then! Minsterhorn! Only, the more I thought
about it, the less I knew what to sing about.
And then a thought came to meee♪

Someone who didn't grow up here, someone like you,
might see the place a little differently.

What do you say? Between the two of us,
let's find something in this village worth a song!

I'd like you to talk to the villagers.
Pick someone who doesn't wander off all the time like I do.

Why can't I ask them? Oh, we'd get to talking
about old times and never get any further.

See what folks have to say. If it gives you an idea,
come back and tell me, will you? I'll be here!

Have a word with the villagers, and if you think
of something, come and tell me!

I see.
You'd like to know what I like about this village.

I'm hardly the friendliest man you'll ever meet,
yet folks here make me welcome. I'm grateful for that.

...Oh, you meant something like a local specialty?
Well, everything we grow in our fields tastes good.

I'd go for the tomatoes. They're firm and full of flavor.
The celery tastes good, too, and gives a dish a lovely aroma.

Here, take some with you, if you like.
And tell Blue Lin I'm rooting for him.

I'd go for the tomatoes and the celery.
Both are grown here in Minsterhorn, and both are delicious.
I'd be grateful if you'd pass that along to Blue Lin.

Rody had some vegetables to spare?
Tomatoes and celery. Look how fresh they are!
Come to think of it, we've always had good vegetables here.

We've got plenty of expert growers besides Rody.
Then again, vegetables grow all over the Asteria Plains.

...I know! What if we had someone cook these up?
Shall we go and ask?
A friend of mine named Melis works at the tavern.

I bet she could come up with something.
Let's go see her.

My friend Melis might be able to make
something special with these vegetables.

Hello, Melis. I was hoping you'd do me a little favor.
You see...

You want me to make something special with these?
That's a lot to spring on a girl...

Oh, please, Melis.
I remember what a good cook you are.

Rody was kind enough to give us these vegetables.
I'd feel awful letting them go to waste.

Wait. Rody grew these?
Why didn't you say so?

I'll do it! I'll do it!
Please, let me cook them!

What's come over you? Oh, that's right.
You've always had a soft spot for Rody...

I don't have any feelings for Rody
whatsoever!

Eek! Blue Lin, cut that out!
Just give me a minute, will you?

Still, I never thought I'd see the day
when Blue Lin would write a song about home.

It took getting out and seeing the world to realize
how wonderful my home is. I want to sing about that.

Thanks! Now, how about being
that honest with Rody?

I-I told you, this has nothing to do with Rody!
Here! Soup's ready!

It certainly smells good enough to make my mouth water.
But look at it! Plain with a capital P!

Tsk, tsk. You've got a lot to learn if you're judging by looks.
Try a spoonful and then tell me what you think.

Well then, let's have a taste.
...!! That's goooood!

How did you do that? It's such a simple soup,
but there's so much flavor in it!

Like it? Minsterhorn's famous for its capers, too.
The trick is to put in a whole heap♪

...Hey, wait a minute! All you've done is eat!
Have you heard a word I've said?!

Ah, that was delicious! Yes!
I feel a song coming on!

♪ ...tomatoooes♪ ...celeryyy♪
...♪ ...Got it!

Off he goes. Always does things his own way.
Go and give him a listen if you like.

For all his antics, he takes his music seriously.
Oh, I know... Maybe I'll ask Rody to come along.

Blue Lin's singing his song in the middle of the village.
Go and give him a listen if you like.
Right! That looks like a crowd to me.

Thanks for waiting, everyone! Here's a new song for you.
I call it “Minsterhorn's Finest Soup.”

Tomatoooes♪ ...won't do on their ooown♪
Add some celeryyy, and you still need mooore♪

Souuup? Oh, the secret iiiis...!
Capers! It was you all alooong♪

What was that nonsense all about?
Come on, we're going home. What a waste of time.

Aww, I thought it was funny!
I liked how weird it was!

Hey! Stop that!
Don't go learning that silly song!

You know that soup that gave him the idea for the song?
I made it.

You did?
I'd love to try some myself.

Th-then come over to my place right now!
I'll give you all you can eat.

Well, I seem to have won a few hearts,
but I could use a bit more practice.

I want to be a “publicity poet”!
Thanks to you, I can finally put a name to it♪

Now to spread the word about all the other villages!
Here I gooo♪
W-water... Please...!

Thank you...
I can finally get a few words out.

It's my cousin Katchua's fault.
You wouldn't believe what she cooked up!

It looked like perfectly ordinary soup.
Tasted fine, too. The trouble started a little later!

I started going numb and slurring my words...
By the time I got here, I couldn't move at all.

Katchua doesn't know what happened yet.
And she made far too much soup, so now...

I-it's happening again...!
Her house is at the far end of the village. H-hurry...!

I can't... I can barely... talk anymore...
I'm counting... on you...! Thud.

Oh, hello there, adventurer.
Have your travels left you hungry?

I've made rather too much soup.
Do help yourself if you'd like some.
What? Melis told you to stop me? Why?

...She went numb after eating my soup?
Oh, you must be kidding!

Besides, I'm not supposed to
eat this particular soup myself.

I wonder what went wrong, though.
Hmm. I really do wish I had the recipe.

Oh, I know. An adventurer like you must know all sorts of things.
Would you give me a hand?

It seems I can't quite make it from memory...
I'd better find a proper recipe.

I hear there's quite a library upstairs at the Reclamation Bureau
in Asterleeds. Do you know it?

Please, adventurer.
Would you take me to Asterleeds?

There might still be a recipe in the library
upstairs at the Reclamation Bureau in Asterleeds.

Please.
Would you take me to the library in Asterleeds?

Let's see... Books about Minsterhorn...
Oh, here's one!

That's why the bride isn't allowed to eat any herself.
It's a bit of a shame after all that cooking.

What a relief. The recipe's right here.
Hmm... I had most of the ingredients right, though.

Then each family adds an ingredient of its own.
That's the one part I do remember clearly.

But people picked too many of them.
Now there are no Crescent Mushrooms to be found anywhere.

I used Jellyfish Mushrooms because the flavor's similar.
Apparently there's something in them that makes you go numb.

Oh, I know!
What if I put a medicinal herb in with the mushrooms?

An herb for numbness... Here we are. Young Mua Leaves.
There's no shortage of those up in the mountains.

Adventurer, could you go and gather
some Young Mua Leaves for me?

I'll go home and start a fresh batch.
I'm going to get this soup right this time!
I'll go home and start another pot of soup.

You're just in time.
Now, chop them up and into the pot they go...

All done! My very own Wedding Soup.
Melis, have a taste.

I did, but... You're using the same ingredients, aren't you?
I just saw you put in a whole heap of Jellyfish Mushrooms.

Has it ever occurred to you that you could just
leave the Jellyfish Mushrooms out?

But that's what makes it taste like our family's soup.
That's the one thing I won't give up.

Oh, all right. In for a penny, as they say.
I've come this far. I'll see it through.

God of Bapharia, thank you for today's blessings.
Please keep me safe. ...Here goes.

W-wait... What is this?!
It's absolutely delicious!

It's so mellow, and there's such depth to the flavor.
It might even be better than my aunt's soup!

My tongue isn't numb at all. I feel healthier already!
You could be proud to serve this to anyone!

I did it! Adventurer, I finally got it right!
Thank you so much!

Now I can walk proudly into my wedding. Mother can rest easy.
Thank you too, Melis.

Yeah, yeah. Thanks. I've had my fill.
In more ways than one.

Now all that's left is to wait for your sweetheart to come home.
You still haven't heard a word from Yoan?

No. That's quite normal for him.
I don't mind waiting.

My fiancé's an adventurer too. He's in Ritze at the moment.
His travels often take him far from home.

Tell him I'll have some delicious soup waiting, too,
so he'd better hurry home.
